title: Expose AllowedPythonDirs config in TUI Settings
overview:
Users can only configure allowed Python directories by manually editing ~/.config/aprd/config.yaml.

**Motivation:** Provides consistent configuration experience through TUI instead of requiring manual config file editing.

**Technical constraints:**
- Add TUI input field in Settings tab for managing allowed Python directories

**Signals:** priority: high
problem_statement: Users can only configure allowed Python directories by manually editing ~/.config/aprd/config.yaml.
motivation: Provides consistent configuration experience through TUI instead of requiring manual config file editing.
technical_constraints: Add TUI input field in Settings tab for managing allowed Python directories
resolution_notes: Already implemented on master. AllowedPythonDirs has full TUI integration: inAllowedPythonDirs input field in model.go, accessors in keys_settings.go, rendered in view_settings.go, and wired to config via parsePathList() in run.go. The feature allows users to configure allowed Python directories directly from the TUI Settings tab.
